Let \(L=\log n\), and write
\[
c=aL,\qquad d=bL.
\]
Using
\[
\frac1{k+a}=\int_0^1 x^{k+a-1}\,dx,
\]
we get
\[
A_N(a)=\int_0^1 x^{a-1}(1-x)^N\,dx
=B(a,N+1)=\frac{\Gamma(a)\Gamma(N+1)}{\Gamma(N+a+1)}.
\]
The common factor \(\Gamma(a)\) cancels from \(R_n\), so define
\[
f_p(a)=\frac{\Gamma(n^p+1)}{\Gamma(n^p+a+1)}.
\]
Then
\[
R_n(a,b)=\frac{f_4(a)}{f_1(a)+n^b f_3(a)+n^{2b}f_6(a)}.
\]

For small \(a\sim L^{-1}\),
\[
f_p(a)=n^{-pa}\left(1-\frac{a(a+1)}{2n^p}+o(n^{-p}L^{-1})\right).
\]
Only the \(p=1\) correction matters at scale \(1/(nL)\). Thus the denominator is, to the needed order,
\[
S=e^{-c-\frac{c}{2nL}}+e^{d-3c}+e^{2d-6c}.
\]
Let \(\delta=(nL)^{-1}\). The logarithm is
\[
\log R_n=-4c-\log S+o(\delta).
\]

At leading order, set
\[
t_1=e^{-c},\qquad t_3=e^{d-3c},\qquad t_6=e^{2d-6c}.
\]
The first derivative condition says the weighted mean of \(\{1,3,6\}\) is \(4\). The third derivative condition says the third central moment is \(0\). Hence the limiting weights are
\[
(w_1,w_3,w_6)=\left(\frac1{10},\frac12,\frac25\right).
\]
Therefore
\[
\frac{t_3}{t_1}=5,\qquad \frac{t_6}{t_1}=4,
\]
so
\[
d-2c=\log 5,\qquad 2d-5c=\log 4.
\]
This gives
\[
c=\log\frac{25}{4},\qquad d=\log\frac{3125}{16},
\]
and therefore
\[
d-3c=\log\frac45.
\]

Now keep the first correction. The corrected slopes are
\[
1+\frac{\delta}{2},\qquad 3,\qquad 6.
\]
Solving the same mean and third-central-moment equations to first order gives weight perturbations
\[
w_1=\frac1{10}+\delta\frac3{25},\quad
w_3=\frac12-\delta\frac16,\quad
w_6=\frac25+\delta\frac7{150}.
\]
Write
\[
c=c_0+\delta C,\qquad d=d_0+\delta D.
\]
The two log-ratio perturbations are
\[
\alpha=D-2C+\frac{c_0}{2},\qquad
\beta=2D-5C+\frac{c_0}{2}.
\]
Matching the weight perturbations gives
\[
5\alpha+4\beta=-12,\qquad -30\alpha+36\beta=7,
\]
so
\[
\alpha=-\frac{23}{15},\qquad \beta=-\frac{13}{12}.
\]
Thus
\[
D-3C=\beta-\alpha
=-\frac{13}{12}+\frac{23}{15}
=\frac9{20}.
\]
Since
\[
(b_n-3a_n)L-\log\frac45
=d-3c-\log\frac45
=\frac{1}{nL}\cdot\frac9{20}+o\!\left(\frac1{nL}\right),
\]
we conclude
\[
\boxed{\frac9{20}}.
\]
